programme.title: Qalb Ommoh
programme.desc: When Magdy is critically injured in a fight, the doctors struggle to save his life when he requires a heart transplant. But Younis' mother dies and the doctors transplant her heart to Magdy who starts acting in a motherly way towards Younis.
